title: Align GLOBAL instructions with D10-D13, D18, D21 and D22
body:
GLOBAL AGENTS.md demands a full local gate (D11 says CI runs it), the delegate and delivery-loop skills give model and judge policy that contradicts D18/D22, the repair loop has no round limit where it is owned (D10), D12/D13 have no owner, global krn does not forward review, wayfinder can default to a markdown tracker, and krn_capsule.py tells sessions to claim tasks.
Acceptance: one owner per rule in GLOBAL config/AGENTS.md and skills, matching ADR 0014; pinned instruction tests updated; changes check clean.
